body: We have some files with windows line feed, dunno why. We can force it from gitattributes. Anyone with git powerskills can check this? :)

comments.body:
I never really understood how git deals with line-ending. I have `safecrlf = false autocrlf = input` in my `~/.gitconfig` but I must confess I do not remember why.

From what I read, your config change seems nice :)
Do you guys know which of you has an editor putting `\r\n` because indeed I was that in some files?
I found it only in documentation.md. I suspect github edit was maybe the issue
Did you found any other file? (I plan on moving all the bad newline when we are good with all the modifications, just for my github stats) :trollface:
